create_tokenizer_from_version: create a Gemma tokenizer instance from a version number like 2, 3, or 3n
encode_text_to_tokens: encode a string into a list of token ids with optional bos and eos tokens
decode_token_ids_to_text: decode a list of token ids or numpy array back into readable text
split_text_into_pieces: split a string into subword token pieces using the sentencepiece model
plot_token_probability_distribution: plot a bar chart of the top tokens from model logits using plotly
